conditions: One or more products have been added to the cart
User navigates to the cart page
items.expected: The cart page is shown (navigation to cart URL occurred); each added product appears in the cart list with its quantity, name and price visible

conditions: At least one product is in the cart
User clicks Remove on a product
items.expected: The removed product disappears from the cart list (list is now shorter); the cart badge count decreases by one

conditions: One product is in the cart
User clicks Continue Shopping from the cart
items.expected: The user is taken back to the product list page (URL changes to product list); the cart badge still shows the same count as before

conditions: Cart page with at least one product in the cart
axe-core scan of the cart form/container
Unauthenticated user navigates directly to the cart URL
items.expected: The cart page is not shown; user is redirected away (e.g. back to login)

excluded.what: confirmation — bug #121 (Active: problem user sees same picture for every product)
excluded.reason: Bug #121 is about the product list page image rendering, not the cart review behaviour covered by story #114

excluded.reason: Bug #122 is about checkout completion (story #117/#120 territory), not the cart review behaviour covered by story #114
